description: Best-effort text redaction patterns, limits, and literal-secret replacement.

dos: Describe text redaction as best-effort and document supported patterns, including common authorization and bearer values, named and environment assignments, query secrets, provider tokens, JWTs, public/private key material, and opaque secrets.
Accept maxString as a non-negative integer with a default of 10,000; ensure returned text does not exceed it.
Process input coercion and redaction before truncating the result; maxString bounds output rather than coercion and inspection work.
Append [TRUNCATED] when input or replacement expansion requires truncation and the configured limit can fit the marker.
Use the fixed [REDACTED] marker for sensitive-value replacement.
Accept an optional iterable secrets value, replace non-empty string entries literally, and ignore non-string entries.
Process at most 100 configured literal secrets using bounded repeated replacement.
donts: Do not claim text redaction detects arbitrary unknown secrets.
Do not confuse [TRUNCATED] with the fixed [REDACTED] marker.
Do not imply marker customization or unbounded configured-secret processing is supported.
